test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Quant (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A stock portfolio consists of three stocks. Stock A represents 30% of the portfolio and has a return of 5%. Stock B represents 40% of the portfolio and has a return of 10%. Stock C represents the remaining 30% of the portfolio and has a return of 8%. What is the average return of the portfolio?
solution:
**Given:**

Stock A: 30% of the portfolio, Return: 5%

Stock B: 40% of the portfolio, Return: 10%

Stock C: 30% of the portfolio, Return: 8%

**Formula Used:**

Average Return = (Weight of A × Return of A) + (Weight of B × Return of B) + (Weight of C × Return of C)
